source_claims.statement: Standard reconnaissance on Angular app under /api/v0/; JS bundles examined; data collector endpoint found with default token that granted access.

Error messages used to reverse JSON structure of filters array (type + values). Injection in values and name fields returned normal responses (negative). Pivot to type field produced PostgreSQL errors.
Confirmed via pg_sleep timing differences (1s and 5s).

research_questions.formulation: Does the compliance profiles search endpoint properly sanitize filter type fields when accessed with a default data-collector token?
research_questions.anchor: pivot after negative results on values/name
research_questions.uncertainty_reduced: whether type field is concatenated into SQL
research_questions.assumption_challenged: that all filter inputs are sanitized equally

environment_model_updates: Angular frontend with gRPC-gateway backend (grpc-metadata-content-type headers)
Default data-collector token exists and is sufficient for compliance endpoints
filters array structure recovered from error messages

systematic_vs_exploratory.systematic: endpoint enumeration, JS analysis, sequential testing of injection points
systematic_vs_exploratory.exploratory_or_unexpected: use of known default token (prior experience) that unlocked protected surface

negative_inconclusive: values and name fields showed no injection behavior (bounded negative on those fields)
unobserved_history: exact tools used for initial recon
whether default token was looked up or recalled from memory
forbidden_inferences: Do not claim the default token was discovered purely by scanning; source attributes it to knowledge of common configurations
Negative results on values/name do not prove the endpoint is generally safe
next_evidence_actions: Note CVE-2025-8868 assignment and recommended upgrade version
layer_b_candidate_principles: When an API returns structured errors, recover the expected schema before assuming injection points are exhausted
Default or well-known tokens can expand the testable attack surface; treat them as environment facts worth verifying
model_vs_harness: Prior knowledge of default tokens is model/experience; systematic field-by-field testing and error recovery can be harness-supported.
